We have now made our way into Day 2 of the massive Amazon Black Friday sale with all-time lows on Apple Watch Series 12, AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off, MacBook Neo from $649, and a fantastic price drop on the most affordable M5 MacBook Air at $1,049. However, Amazon has now dropped the price even lower on AirPods Max 2 at $130 off, we have iPhone Air new unlocked at nearly $300 off for Black Friday (or Best Buy open-box units up to a massive $799 off ), and loads of deals on Beats headphones and buds at up to 53% off the list prices (the new 360 are now $100 off ). Those deals join the ongoing all-time lows on M6 MacBook Pro at $150 off, Apple Studio Displays at $200 off, and a brilliant deal on the Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter at $32.
